kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: Hong Kong official warns booksellers on security risks after raids
wire.summary: The police operation marks the third round of arrests targeting independent bookstores in four months.

wire.title: Trump wants a permanent fence around the D.C. park known for White House protests
wire.summary: The Trump administration wants to install permanent fencing around Lafayette Park, directly outside the White House. It's long been a popular spot for protesters, who worry barriers will change that.

wire.title: Zelenskyy fires Ukraine's tech-savvy defense minister in government reshuffle
wire.summary: Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has fired the country's popular defense minister, who pushed for innovation in the battlefield through the use of drones and turned the tables on Russia.

wire.title: The political risks from war in Iran. And, ICE's use of force is rising, report finds
wire.summary: The political implications the war in Iran is having on the GOP. And, a new report has found that ICE officers' use of force is not rare since President Trump took office for his second term.

wire.title: Oil companies are making billions. In the U.S., calls to tax their windfall are growing
wire.summary: Higher oil prices since the Iran war began mean many oil companies have brought in excess profits. Some U.S. lawmakers want to tax those windfall profits and give the money to lower-income Americans.

wire.title: Bike lanes and speed cameras disappear from the DOT's list of proven safety measures
wire.summary: The Federal Highway Administration quietly stripped bike lanes and other safety recommendations from a key list of best practices. Critics say those measures are proven to cut crashes and save lives.

wire.title: No Asian team managed to go far this World Cup (again). What's holding them back?
wire.summary: For the sixth World Cup in a row, no team from the Asian Football Confederation made it past the first knockout round, winning only three games out of 29. Asian teams are competitive — up to a point.

wire.title: 'Gossip' had godly origins. Here's how it gained its sinful reputation
wire.summary: We've all engaged in a little 'gossip.' But did you know its origins were tied to family and friendship?

wire.title: Trump earned billions last year. Some Pennsylvania swing voters say they don't care
wire.summary: Key voters in Pennsylvania are split on whether President Trump earning a big windfall last year is a big deal or not. Their reaction reveals a level of cynicism about many in the political class.

wire.title: TrumpRx promised a supermarket for cheaper drugs but delivered a boutique
wire.summary: President Trump said TrumpRx is the biggest thing to happen in healthcare in decades. But an NPR analysis finds drugmakers are only offering deals on a few of their medicines.

wire.title: Italian officials handed jail terms for Genoa bridge disaster that killed 43
wire.summary: The ex-head of Italy's motorway operator Giovanni Castellucci was handed a 12-year term over the 2018 bridge collapse.

wire.title: Zelensky's removal of popular defence minister sparks protests in Ukraine
wire.summary: A rift between Fedorov and Commander-in-Chief Oleksandr Syrskyi was apparently at the heart of Zelensky's decision.

wire.title: Teenager accused of carrying out sabotage actions in Poland for Russia
wire.summary: Polish security services say the aim was to incite ethnic tensions between Poland and Ukraine.

wire.title: Iran targets military bases as US launches wave of strikes
wire.summary: Explosions were heard across Iran overnight, shortly after neighbouring Gulf states began to report attacks.

wire.title: More than 800 Canadian wildfires burning as air quality alerts extend to US
wire.summary: The air quality in large parts of Michigan, Minneapolis and Minnesota is deemed "hazardous" by authorities.

wire.title: Argentina face action over Falklands banner
wire.summary: Argentina face the prospect of disciplinary action from Fifa after their players celebrate the World Cup semi-final win against England with a banner in support of their country's claims to the Falkland Islands.
